CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #20
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Inspired Word of God? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Inspired Word of God with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Inspired Word of God.
   C. Use Inspired Word of God to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Inspired Word of God has no place in daily life.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Leisure? (1 mark)
   A. Say Leisure has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Leisure.
   C. Apply the teaching of Leisure with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Leisure to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

4. Which response best shows understanding of Jacob Wrestles an Angel? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Jacob Wrestles an Angel.
   B. Apply the teaching of Jacob Wrestles an Angel with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Jacob Wrestles an Angel to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Jacob Wrestles an Angel has no place in daily life.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Miracle of Healing? (1 mark)

   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Miracle of Healing.
   C. Say Miracle of Healing has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Miracle of Healing with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

7. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Stories Samson defeats the Philistines? (1 mark)
   A. Say Bible Stories Samson defeats the Philistines has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Bible Stories Samson defeats the Philistines to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Bible Stories Samson defeats the Philistines with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible Stories Samson defeats the Philistines.

8. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

9. Which response best shows understanding of My Purpose? (1 mark)
   A. Say My Purpose has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing My Purpose.
   C. Apply the teaching of My Purpose with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use My Purpose to insult classmates of other faiths.

10. Which response best shows understanding of The Call of Disciples? (1 mark)

11. Which response best shows understanding of The Temptations of Jesus Christ? (1 mark)

   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Temptations of Jesus Christ.
   C. Say The Temptations of Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.
   D. Use The Temptations of Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.

12. Which response best shows understanding of The Ten Commandments? (1 mark)
   A. Use The Ten Commandments to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Ten Commandments.
   C. Say The Ten Commandments has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of The Ten Commandments with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

13. Which response best shows understanding of Faith in God Elisha? (1 mark)
   A. Say Faith in God Elisha has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Faith in God Elisha.
   C. Apply the teaching of Faith in God Elisha with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Faith in God Elisha to insult classmates of other faiths.

14. Which response best shows understanding of Miracles of Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Miracles of Jesus Christ.
   B. Apply the teaching of Miracles of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Miracles of Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Miracles of Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.

15. Which response best shows understanding of Marriage and Family? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Marriage and Family with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Marriage and Family has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Marriage and Family to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Marriage and Family.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
